clare-partnerships: Hey team — quick ask for the cost model. We need two things from our HW partners to finalize pricing guidance: 1) reserved SKU list with price tiers (1/3/12/36 mo where available) and any early-termination or cliff rules; 2) spot/preemptible eviction rates and average availability by region over the last 90 days. CSV preferred but a short bulleted reply works.
coreweave-rep: Thanks @clare-partnerships. I can pull both. Quick clarifying q: do you need effective price after marketplace fee or base rack rate? Also interested in which SKUs you want (A100-80GB, H100-80GB, L40)?
clare-partnerships: Effective price after marketplace fee please (our cost model needs net unit cost). Start with A100-80GB and H100-80GB. If you have a consolidated SKU for smaller quant sizes (e.g., 4/GPU pack) include that too.
coreweave-rep: Got it. Sharing high level now:
• Reserved tiers: 1mo: $9.5/hr, 3mo: $8.6/hr, 12mo: $7.0/hr, 36mo: $6.1/hr (A100-80GB, pre-fee)
• Marketplace fee: 7% by default, education credits may subtract another 1-2% (partner-level promo)
• Early-term: pro-rate remaining term but 10% admin fee on refunds, cliff at 14 days for cancellations on short terms
• Spot: average eviction rate: us-west: 8%, us-east: 6%, eu-west: 10% over 90d; avg availability windows ~ 12–18 hrs/day for A100
james-finance: Thanks — can you add the standard GAAP-style invoice lag (net30/45) and whether reserved SKUs have volume-tier discounts (e.g., >100 GPUs gets -0.25/hr)? Those affect effective cost when amortized.
coreweave-rep: Yes net30 standard. Volume tiers: tier1(1-49): no discount, tier2(50-199): 3% off reserved rate, tier3(200+): 7% off. Those are stackable with contract promos but not with marketplace-credit offers.
amanda-cto: One more item — what's your observed latency/throughput variance when switching to spot fallback? We're modeling degradation penalty (tokens/sec) when failing over to smaller instance types.
coreweave-rep: For A100->smaller fallback (e.g., A10-ish), median latency regresses ~1.6x for throughput-bound workloads. For bursty low-latency, we recommend multi-pool fallback to H100 spare capacity if available — hit rate ~30% in us-west.
clare-partnerships: Perfect. Can you drop the CSV to this thread or S3 with read link? Also flag any contract clauses that affect our right to re-route traffic (preempt/spot SLA) — need legal check.
coreweave-rep: I'll upload CSV tonight: columns = sku, term_mos, base_hr, marketplace_fee_pct, effective_hr, region, spot_eviction_pct_90d, avg_spot_hours_per_day, early_term_fee_pct, volume_tier, payment_terms. Will ping when done.
ops-bot: Uploaded: s3://partners-coreweave/exports/partner-pricing-1717004321.csv (permissions: partners-team read). :white_check_mark:
james-finance: I pulled the CSV and will run scenario sims tomorrow (sensitivity to eviction rates + volume tiers). If eviction >12% we should assume 20% higher amortized infra cost in baseline.
clare-partnerships: Great — after james' sims we'll sync with legal on routing rights and then finalize the marketplace price guidance for the public docs. Thanks everyone :pray:
